name: antigravity-extension-sync
description: Cross-platform synchronization for agent configuration files and rules.

commands.title: Antigravity Sync: Upload Config to Cloud
Antigravity Sync: Download Config from Cloud
Antigravity Sync: Open Cloud Gist in Browser

antigravitySync.gistId.description: Secret Gist ID used for storing configuration. Leave blank to auto-create.

antigravitySync.autoSyncOnStartup.description: Automatically download latest config from cloud when editor launches (default: false).

antigravitySync.autoSyncOnSave.description: Automatically upload to cloud when config files or GEMINI.md are saved (default: false).

antigravitySync.customPath.description: Custom path to .gemini directory. If empty, automatically detected by OS.
